test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which app has been released for the first time by the Education Ministry to learn spoken sentences in 22 languages?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhasha Sangam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to Union Minister of State for Education, **Dr. Subhash Sarkar, **the government is preparing to launch the Bhasha Sangam mobile app.
 
• The smartphone app aims to introduce users to frequently used words in scheduled Indian languages during **daily speech.**
 
• To learn basic conversation in 22 Indian languages, test yourself and generate online certification, the program offers over 100 statements with different topics.
 
• The app encourages the concept of **Ek Bharat Shreshtha Bharat** by enabling people across India to learn multiple languages of different Indian states and know their cultures better.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• One of the unmet needs of our society for high quality training in English is fulfilled by **English Pro.**
 
• Companies that provide transportation for their employees, educational institutions that provide transportation for students, fleet/cargo service providers, and any other company that manages their on-site executives can all use the** Sarathi** app.
 
• **IEPFA** It was created to encourage public participation, disseminate knowledge to encourage investor awareness and protection, and achieve financial literacy in both rural and urban areas.
